source.episode_title: On His Way to Die, Jesus Stopped
source.anchor_kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
source.thread: A blind beggar, Bartimaeus, cried to Jesus, Son of David, for mercy by the road near Jericho; many told him to be quiet and he cried louder; Jesus, on the road to Jerusalem where He would be killed, stood still and called him; he threw off his cloak and came; Jesus asked what he wanted, he asked for his sight, and Jesus said his faith had made him whole; at once he could see and he followed Jesus on the road to Jerusalem, where Jesus died for our sins and rose the third day

Source poc_desert_storybook_heroes/bartimaeus/words/LOCKED_WORDS.md --> BARTIMAEUS: Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me. NARRATOR: Many told the blind beggar to be quiet. NARRATOR: His name was Bartimaeus. He sat begging by the road near Jericho. "Son of David" meant God's promised King. NARRATOR: Jesus was on the road to Jerusalem. He had told His followers He would be killed there. Would He stop for a beggar? NARRATOR: But Bartimaeus shouted even louder. BARTIMAEUS: Thou Son of David, have mercy on me. NARRATOR: "And Jesus stood still." A whole crowd was moving. He stopped for one man, and called for him. NARRATOR: Bartimaeus threw off his cloak and came. Jesus asked him what he wanted: JESUS: What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? BARTIMAEUS: Lord, that I might receive my sight. JESUS: Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. NARRATOR: He trusted Jesus. Jesus made him well. At once he could see. NARRATOR: He was free to go anywhere. He chose to follow Jesus. NARRATOR: Up the road to Jerusalem. NARRATOR: There Jesus died on a cross for our sins, for the wrong things we have done. NARRATOR: On the third day, He rose to life. NARRATOR: On His way to die and rise again, Jesus stood still for one man.

Blind Bartimaeus in the Bible (Mark 10:46-52): a whole crowd told him to be quiet, and Jesus was on His way to die. Would He stop?

He sat begging by the road near Jericho and cried out to Jesus as the Son of David, God's promised King. Many told him to hold his peace. He cried out even more.

"And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee." (Mark 10:49, KJV)

Read the whole story: Mark 10:46-52 (and Mark 10:32-34).

On His way to the cross, Jesus stood still for one man. He still hears the one who calls.

redteam:
VERDICT: REVISE
- ALL platforms, "a whole crowd told him to be quiet" / "A whole crowd said be quiet" / Facebook title "The Crowd Said Be Quiet": OVERCLAIM. Mark 10:48 says "many charged him that he should hold his peace", not the whole crowd. Fix: "many told him to be quiet" / "Many Said Be Quiet. Jesus Stood Still."
- youtube_short + youtube_long closer "He still hears the one who calls.": not in the video and not in Mark 10; it is an application the film never makes. Fix: cut it, or end on the film's own line "On His way to die and rise again, Jesus stood still for one man."
- youtube_short "On His way to the cross, Jesus stood still for one man.": paraphrases the film's last line; use the film's exact wording "On His way to die and rise again" so the description does not drift from the narration.
- Footer "": conflicts with the channel owner's standing rule (no method wording in public text; platform AI switches are a setting). Remove from every platform body.
- TikTok first line is strong; keep it but apply the "many" fix. Instagram: 5 hashtags is fine.
- KJV quote of Mark 10:49 is verbatim. Title is honest: Mark 10:33-34 has Jesus foretelling His death on this road, and v49 has Him stand still.
